serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Annalie.Face.shocked
Lady Annalie: W-wait a minute!
Lady Annalie: You again?! How much clothes does your girl need? Did her closet burn to a crisp? Did she lose a lot of weight? What’s going on?!
You: No question asked, remember?
Lady Annalie: W-well, you may be right, but I’m still curious, you know?
You: C-calm down, ok? It’s not like I’m doing something bad.
#Annalie.Face.normal
Lady Annalie: Then I guess I have nothing to worry about. 
#Annalie.Face.eyeClosed
Lady Annalie: How about you come with her next time, huh? I’m eager to meet her and look through clothes together!
Damn, I can’t really risk Lady Annalie finding out my ‘girlfriend’ is a bot.
You: M-maybe later, she’s busy and stuff.
#Annalie.Face.shocked
Lady Annalie: That was a really evasive answer!
#Annalie.Face.pervyGrin
Lady Annalie: Ah~ I can’t help but to get even more curious and excited~
Ugh! I made a mistake! Weirdo got horny!
You: Oh my! Just look at the time. It’s so late already. I gotta go home, bye!
#Annalie.Face.shocked
Lady Annalie: W-what?! W-wai-
